briefings.title: Comer Defends 'Very Transparent' Lutnick After Epstein Interview, Accuses Dems Of 'Cover Up'
briefings.tldr: Chairman James Comer defended Howard Lutnick’s "very transparent" voluntary testimony regarding his minimal history with Jeffrey Epstein, while accusing House Democrats of lying to the media and prioritizing social media optics over the substance of the investigation.
